requirements.requirement_text: **Normative owner directive:** ALL development of the new SmartSIHub platform SHALL be initiated, orchestrated, observed and accepted through the *currently running* `https://smartaihub.app` Autonomous Implements / Autonomous Mini App Creator facilities, using their existing SPEC-224 Job/Run, Runner, Workspace, Harness and deployment authorities. `smartaihub.app` is the **temporary development control plane**, not the new SaaS Core implementation or the new production domain.
